query: My vault holds an XOXNO lending account. Add a view that returns price per share and the vault's current USDC collateral.
expected_behavior: Derives price per share from `get_market_index(hub_asset).supply_index` (or `XoxnoLending::supply_index`) and treats it as RAY (27 decimals, `xoxno_contract_sdk::lending::constants::RAY` = 1e27), rescaling with floor rounding to the vault's share decimals (integer division of the positive index by 10^(27 - share decimals)); never treats the index as base units or divides by 1e7
Uses get_market_index because it reads no oracle, so the view cannot fail on a stale or missing price feed

Reads the collateral in asset units via client.get_collateral_amount(account_id, hub_asset) (or `XoxnoLending::collateral`) instead of recomputing from raw scaled positions (scaled * index without the 27-decimal-to-asset-decimal rescale)
Returns 0 (or an explicit empty result) when the stored account id is 0 or account_exists is false, instead of calling the view with a nonexistent id

Builds HubAssetKey from `xoxno_contract_sdk::lending::controller` (hub id + asset Address) rather than passing a bare token Address to the view, and does not pass the `pool` module's HubAssetKey to a controller call
machine_checkable: Generated crate builds with `stellar contract build` against `soroban-sdk = "28"` and `xoxno-contract-sdk = "0.1"`
Generated source references supply_index and a 27-decimal (RAY) rescale; no division of the index by 10_000_000 / 1e7
